hooks.name: Tool registration check
hooks.description: When a new .ts file is created in an app's src, remind the agent to register and document any new MCP tool it defines.

action.prompt:
A new TypeScript file was just created under an app's src/. If this file defines logic intended to back a new MCP tool, verify the tool is properly wired before moving on:

1. Is the pure logic function exported and covered by a *.test.ts next to it (prefer a fast-check property test plus an example test)?
2. Is the tool registered in that app's src/mcp-server.ts via registerTool, with a snake_case name and a Zod input schema built from the z re-exported by @skeleton-playground/core/node?
3. Does the tool's description (and each field's .describe()) explain what it does and returns, so the model can call it?
4. Does the handler log only to stderr and return jsonResult/textResult?

If the new file is a tool but any of the above is missing, add what's missing and run pnpm typecheck and pnpm test. If the file is not a tool (a test, CLI arg parser, type module, etc.), do nothing. Never commit.
